text_en: Now Joseph was taken down to Egypt, and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, the captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him from the Ishmaelites who had brought him down there.
text_cn: 若瑟被人带到埃及，有个埃及人普提法尔，是法郎的内臣兼卫队长，从带若瑟来的依市玛耳人手里买了他。

text_en: The Lord was with Joseph, and he became a successful man; he was in the house of his Egyptian master.
text_cn: 上主与若瑟同在，他便事事顺利，住在他埃及主人家里。

text_en: His master saw that the Lord was with him, and that the Lord caused all that he did to prosper in his hands.
text_cn: 他主人见上主与若瑟同在，又见上主使他手中所做的事，无不顺利；

text_en: So Joseph found favor in his sight and attended him; he made him overseer of his house and put him in charge of all that he had.
text_cn: 为此若瑟在他主人眼中得了宠，令他服事自己，托他管理自己的家务，将所有的一切，都交在他手中。

text_en: From the time that he made him overseer in his house and over all that he had, the Lord blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake; the blessing of the Lord was on all that he had, in house and field.
text_cn: 自从主人托他管理家务和所有的一切以来，上主为若瑟的原故，祝福了这埃及人的家庭，他家内和田间所有的一切，都蒙受了上主的祝福。

text_en: So he left all that he had in Joseph’s charge; and, with him there, he had no concern for anything but the food that he ate. Now Joseph was handsome and good-looking.
text_cn: 普提法尔将自己所有的一切，都交在若瑟的手里；只要有他在，除自己所吃的食物外，其余一概不管。若瑟生来体态秀雅，容貌俊美。

text_en: And after a time his master’s wife cast her eyes on Joseph and said, “Lie with me. ”
text_cn: 这些事以后，有一回，主人的妻子向若瑟以目传情，并且说：“你与我同睡吧！”

text_en: But he refused and said to his master’s wife, “Look, with me here, my master has no concern about anything in the house, and he has put everything that he has in my hand.
text_cn: 他立即拒绝，对主人的妻子说：“你看，有我在，家中的事，我主人什么都不管；凡他所有的一切，都交在我手中。

text_en: He is not greater in this house than I am, nor has he kept back anything from me except yourself, because you are his wife. How then could I do this great wickedness, and sin against God? ”
text_cn: 在这一家内，他并不比我更有权势，因为他没有留下一样不交给我；只有你除外，因为你是他的妻子。我怎能做这极恶的事，得罪天主呢？”

text_en: And although she spoke to Joseph day after day, he would not consent to lie beside her or to be with her.
text_cn: 她虽然天天这样对若瑟说，若瑟总不听从与她同睡，与她结合。

text_en: One day, however, when he went into the house to do his work, and while no one else was in the house,
text_cn: 有这么一天，若瑟走进屋内办事，家人都没有在屋里，

text_en: she caught hold of his garment, saying, “Lie with me! ” But he left his garment in her hand, and fled and ran outside.
text_cn: 她便抓住若瑟的衣服说：“与我同睡吧！”若瑟把自己的外衣，舍在她手中，就跑到外面去了。

text_en: When she saw that he had left his garment in her hand and had fled outside,
text_cn: 她一见若瑟把自己的外衣舍在她手中，跑到外面去了。

text_en: she called out to the members of her household and said to them, “See, my husband has brought among us a Hebrew to insult us! He came in to me to lie with me, and I cried out with a loud voice;
text_cn: 就召唤她的家人来，对他们说：“你们看！他给我们带来的希伯来人竟敢调戏我啊！他来到我这里，要与我同睡，我就大声呼喊。

text_en: and when he heard me raise my voice and cry out, he left his garment beside me, and fled outside. ”
text_cn: 他一听见我高声呼喊，把他的衣服舍在我身边，就跑到外面去了。”

text_en: Then she kept his garment by her until his master came home,
text_cn: 她便将若瑟的衣服留在身边，等他的主人回家，

text_en: and she told him the same story, saying, “The Hebrew servant, whom you have brought among us, came in to me to insult me;
text_cn: 她又用同样的话给他讲述说：“你给我们带来的那个希伯来仆人，竟到这里来调戏我。

text_en: but as soon as I raised my voice and cried out, he left his garment beside me, and fled outside. ”
text_cn: 我一高声呼喊，他就把他的衣服舍在我身边，跑到外面去了。”

text_en: When his master heard the words that his wife spoke to him, saying, “This is the way your servant treated me, ” he became enraged.
text_cn: 主人一听见他妻子对他所说：“你的仆人如此如此对待我的话，”便大发愤怒。

text_en: And Joseph’s master took him and put him into the prison, the place where the king’s prisoners were confined; he remained there in prison.
text_cn: 若瑟的主人遂捉住若瑟放在监里，即囚禁君王囚犯人的地方。他虽在那里坐监，

text_en: But the Lord was with Joseph and showed him steadfast love; he gave him favor in the sight of the chief jailer.
text_cn: 上主仍与他同在，对他施恩，使他在狱长眼中得宠；

text_en: The chief jailer committed to Joseph’s care all the prisoners who were in the prison, and whatever was done there, he was the one who did it.
text_cn: 因此狱长将监中所有的囚犯都交在若瑟手中；凡狱中应办的事，都由他办理。

text_en: The chief jailer paid no heed to anything that was in Joseph’s care, because the Lord was with him; and whatever he did, the Lord made it prosper.
text_cn: 凡交在若瑟手中的事，狱长一概不闻不问，因为上主与他同在，凡他所做的，上主无不使之顺遂。
